mapper.select: select count(*) from recipe where author_id = #{id};
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite f JOIN recipe r ON f.recipe_id = r.recipe_id WHERE r.author_id = #{id}

SELECT r.*, u.nick_name AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, COALESCE(f.cnt, 0) AS favoriteCount FROM recipe r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.author_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT recipe_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM favorite GROUP BY recipe_id ) f ON r.recipe_id = f.recipe_id
mapper.update: UPDATE recipe SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE recipe_id = #{recipeId}
UPDATE recipe SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE recipe_id = #{recipeId} AND like_count > 0
